item.title: Portugal elects Socialist Party’s Seguro as president in landslide
item.description: With 95 percent of votes counted, 63-year-old Antonio Jose Seguro is on 66 percent.

item.title: Israel security cabinet approves rules to increase control over West Bank
item.description: The Palestinian presidency calls the decision a 'dangerous' Israeli 'attempt to legalize settlement expansion'.

item.title: Iran arrests prominent reformist politicians, cites links to US, Israel
item.description: Detainees are accused of trying to disrupt Iran's 'political social order' at a time of threats from the US and Israel.

item.title: Hong Kong media mogul Jimmy Lai sentenced to 20 years in prison
item.description: Founder of the now-defunct Apple Daily newspaper gets lengthy sentence under Beijing's national security law.

item.title: Russia-Ukraine war: List of key events, day 1,446
item.description: These are the key developments from day 1,446 of Russia’s war on Ukraine.

item.title: Thailand’s Bhumjaithai set for coalition talks after surprise election win
item.description: Conservative party looks set to win at least 194 seats in Thailand's 500 member House, Thai media say.

item.title: Super Bowl 2026: Seahawks ride defence, Walker to beat Patriots
item.description: Seattle Seahawks produce a dominant defensive display to outmuscle the New England Patriots 29-13.

item.title: Bangladesh’s Jamaat leader Shafiqur Rahman: The man everyone wants to meet
item.description: Until recently, Bangladesh's elite and foreign diplomats avoided the Jamaat leader and his party. Not any more.

item.title: ‘Tool of siege’: Israel’s punishing control of Gaza movement
item.description: Israeli closures have ceased to be temporary 'security measures' and now a daily reality that has redefined survival.

item.title: Japan’s Takaichi vows to deliver on tax cuts after LDP’s ‘historic’ win
item.description: LDP looks set to secure 316 seats in Japan's 500-member house, marking its best result since its founding in 1955.
